# sqlpipe v2.0 release notes

## Breaking change: user name fields

The `/v2/users` endpoint no longer returns the `name` field. It now returns two fields: `first_name` and `last_name`. If your client reads the `name` field, update it before you upgrade. Requests that send the `name` field will fail.

## New: incremental transfers

The `--incremental` flag transfers only the rows that changed since the last run. Without the flag, sqlpipe transfers the full table, as before.

## Faster Parquet writes

sqlpipe writes Parquet files (a compressed column-based file format) 40% faster than v1. You do not have to change your configuration to get this speed.
